engineering.name: agent-workflow-designer

engineering.name: api-design-reviewer

engineering.name: api-test-suite-builder

engineering.name: browser-automation

engineering.name: chaos-engineering

engineering.name: ci-cd-pipeline-builder

engineering.name: codebase-onboarding

engineering.name: coding-agent-rollout

engineering.name: commit-craft
engineering.description: Turn a mix of changes into clean, reviewable commits with good messages, blocking staged secrets and .env files. Use whenever the user says commit this, wants to split work into commits, write a commit message, or is about to push.

engineering.name: database-designer
engineering.description: Design a database schema: tables, relationships, indexes, normalization, SQL vs NoSQL, migration plans. Use whenever the user asks how to structure their data, which database to pick, or before writing DDL.

engineering.name: database-schema-designer
engineering.description: Use when asked for an ERD, table relationships, normalization or a schema migration plan. Produces the ERD and normalized DDL with migration steps.

engineering.name: dependency-auditor

engineering.name: engineering-advanced-skills
engineering.description: Pick the right advanced engineering skill: agents, RAG, MCP, CI/CD, databases, observability, release. Use whenever the user asks which skill fits a task.

engineering.name: env-secrets-manager
engineering.description: Use when auditing .env files, planning credential rotation, chasing a missing env var in production or hardening a repo against leaked secrets. Scans for committed secrets and drift with env_auditor.py.

engineering.name: feature-flags-architect
engineering.description: Use before adding, rolling out or retiring a feature flag or kill switch, or when flag debt piles up. Plans the rollout with rollout_planner.py, finds stale flags with flag_debt_scanner.py and audits kill switches with kill_switch_audit.py.

engineering.name: focused-fix
engineering.description: Use when a whole feature or module is broken and needs fixing end to end ('make X work', 'the Y module is broken'). Maps every file and dependency of the area before changing anything. Single quick bug fixes do not need it.

engineering.name: full-page-screenshot
engineering.description: Use when asked for a full-page or long screenshot of a web page. Captures SPA scroll containers, lazy images and very tall pages through Chrome DevTools Protocol with no extra dependencies.

engineering.name: git-worktree-manager
engineering.description: Use when running several branches or agents in parallel on one repo. Creates worktrees with isolated ports and env via worktree_manager.py and removes stale ones with worktree_cleanup.py.

engineering.name: i18n-localization
engineering.description: Use when adding UI text, adding or shipping a language, reviewing translation files, or building i18n into an app. Checks missing keys, placeholders and CLDR plural forms with locale_sync.py, finds hardcoded strings with hardcoded_strings.py, and builds a pseudo-locale with pseudo_localize.py.

engineering.name: interview-system-designer
engineering.description: Use when designing a hiring loop, competency matrix, scoring rubric or question bank, or checking interviewer calibration. Plans the loop per role with interview_planner.py.

engineering.name: kubernetes-operator
engineering.description: Use when building a Kubernetes operator or CRD (controller-runtime, kubebuilder, operator-sdk, KOPF), before writing the controller. Validates CRDs with crd_validator.py, lints reconcile loops with reconcile_lint.py and scores OperatorHub capability level.

engineering.name: mcp-oauth-triage
engineering.description: Use when an MCP connector that used to authenticate now fails (tool calls 401 after a good token exchange, breaks after refresh, returns another account's data), before changing code. Classifies the fault with oauth_triage.py.

engineering.name: mcp-server-builder
engineering.description: Use when exposing an API as an MCP server or scaffolding a new MCP server in Python or TypeScript, before hand-writing tool wrappers. Generates tools from OpenAPI with openapi_to_mcp.py and validates them with mcp_validator.py.

engineering.name: migration-architect
engineering.description: Plan a migration with zero or minimal downtime: phased plan, compatibility check, rollback scripts, for schemas, databases and services. Load whenever the user must change a live table, move a database or cut over without downtime.

engineering.name: monorepo-navigator
engineering.description: Use for Turborepo, Nx, pnpm-workspace or Lerna setup, affected-only builds, remote caching or a multi-repo to monorepo move. Maps packages and the dependency graph with monorepo_analyzer.py.

engineering.name: observability-designer

engineering.name: performance-profiler
engineering.description: Use for a slow endpoint, memory leak, CPU spike, large bundle or performance budget in Node.js, Python or Go, before optimizing. Measures before and after with performance_profiler.py, flamegraphs and k6 load tests.

engineering.name: pr-review-expert
engineering.description: File-by-file pull request review for bugs, security and quality, with a merge verdict. Load whenever the user asks to review, look over or check a PR or diff before merging.

engineering.name: rag-architect

engineering.name: runbook-generator

engineering.name: secrets-vault-manager

engineering.name: self-eval

engineering.name: ship-gate

engineering.name: skill-security-auditor
engineering.description: Use before installing any skill or plugin from an untrusted source, or when asked if a skill is safe. Scans scripts, SKILL.md and dependencies for exfiltration, dangerous calls and prompt injection with skill_security_auditor.py.

engineering.name: skill-tester
engineering.description: Use when authoring or auditing a skill in this ecosystem, before release. Validates structure with skill_validator.py, runs its scripts with script_tester.py and grades quality and security with quality_scorer.py and security_scorer.py.

engineering.name: slo-architect
engineering.description: Use when defining or reviewing SLOs, SLIs, error budgets or burn-rate alerts. Designs SLOs with slo_designer.py, computes budgets and multi-window burn-rate thresholds with error_budget_calculator.py and catches common SLO bugs with slo_review.py.

engineering.name: spec-driven-workflow
engineering.description: Use when a feature should be specified before coding (acceptance criteria, spec-first, tests from specs). Writes the spec with spec_generator.py, checks it with spec_validator.py and extracts tests with test_extractor.py.

engineering.name: sql-database-assistant
engineering.description: Write, fix and speed up SQL: slow queries, EXPLAIN plans, indexes, ORM migrations (Prisma, Drizzle, SQLAlchemy). Load whenever a query is slow or wrong, the user needs SQL written, or an ORM migration.

engineering.name: tc-tracker

engineering.name: tech-debt-tracker

engineering.name: agent-memory

engineering.name: board

engineering.name: eval

engineering.name: ar-status

engineering.description: Make a file measurably better by trial: faster code, smaller bundle, higher pass rate or prompt score. Use whenever the user wants something optimized against a metric, before hand-tuning; loops edits, keeps wins, resets losses. Needs an eval command.

engineering.name: setup
engineering.description: Use for /autoresearch-agent:setup, or to start a new autoresearch experiment: target, eval command, metric, direction, evaluator.

engineering.name: behuman

engineering.name: caveman
engineering.description: Terse mode: drop filler, articles and pleasantries, keep technical accuracy, about 75% fewer tokens, and stay in it. Load whenever the user asks for fewer words, shorter answers, less tokens, caveman mode or /caveman.

engineering.name: code-tour

engineering.name: data-quality-auditor

Indexes all 20 chapters with a 2016-to-2026 delta, plans reading paths with reading_path_planner.py and diagnoses training failures with training_diagnostics.py.

engineering.name: demo-video

engineering.name: docker-development

engineering.name: grill-me
engineering.description: Interview the user relentlessly about a plan or design until reaching shared understanding, resolving each branch of the decision tree. Use when user wants to stress-test a plan, get grilled on their design, or mentions "grill me".

engineering.name: grill-with-docs

engineering.name: handoff
engineering.description: Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent to pick up, referencing existing artifacts (PRDs, plans, ADRs, issues, commits, diffs) by path or URL instead of duplicating them. engineering.name: helm-chart-builder
engineering.description: Use for any Helm chart to create, review or harden (values.yaml, templates, subcharts, RBAC, pod security), before editing it. Analyzes the chart with chart_analyzer.py and validates values with values_validator.py.

engineering.name: hivemind
engineering.description: Use when delegating grunt work to free opencode workers instead of spending Claude tokens: one worker or a scout, coder and tester swarm in worktrees. Triggers on 'spawn a worker', 'swarm', 'delegate to opencode' or /oc.

engineering.name: skillopt-sleep

business-operations.description: Use when scoring or auditing vendors: scorecards, SLA compliance and service credits, third-party risk tier or a tier-1 vendor review. Runs vendor_scorer.py, sla_compliance_tracker.py and vendor_risk_classifier.py.

commercial.name: channel-economics
commercial.description: Use for a direct vs partner channel review: fully loaded cost to serve, channel ROI and the best channel mix under constraints. Runs cost_to_serve_calculator.py, channel_roi_analyzer.py and channel_mix_optimizer.py.

commercial.name: commercial-forecaster
commercial.description: Use when building a bookings, ARR, pipeline or NRR forecast, or a commit, best-case and pipeline board number. Forecasts with bookings_forecaster.py, projects cohorts with cohort_arr_projector.py and scores stage confidence with funnel_confidence_scorer.py, showing every conversion assumption.

commercial.name: commercial-policy
commercial.description: Use when writing or revising discount rules: discount matrix, approver thresholds, exception flows and the deal framework sales works under. Builds the matrix with discount_matrix_builder.py, routes exceptions with exception_router.py and checks the policy with policy_linter.py.

commercial.name: commercial-skills
commercial.description: Use when a commercial request needs routing (pricing, deal review, discounts, partners, channels, policy, RFPs, forecasts): 'review this deal', 'should we discount'. Lists the commercial skills and routes to one.

commercial.name: deal-desk
commercial.description: Use before closing a deal that needs a discount beyond AE authority, has a redlined MSA or unclear per-deal economics. Scores it with deal_scorer.py, names approvers with discount_approval_router.py and flags risky terms with terms_redliner.py. Never auto-approves.

commercial.name: partnerships-architect
commercial.description: Use when deciding whether to sign a partner, at which tier (referral, reseller, OEM, SI, alliance), with what joint GTM and revshare. Runs partner_tier_classifier.py, revshare_modeler.py and joint_gtm_planner.py.

commercial.name: pricing-strategist
commercial.description: Use when choosing or revisiting pricing: seat, usage, value-based, freemium or hybrid, Van Westendorp willingness-to-pay analysis, or Good/Better/Best tiers. Runs pricing_model_picker.py, wtp_analyzer.py and packaging_designer.py and returns a range, not one number.

commercial.name: rfp-responder
commercial.description: Use when an RFP, RFI, RFQ or security or vendor questionnaire arrives. Parses mandatory vs weighted requirements with rfp_parser.py, drafts proof-point answers with response_drafter.py and estimates win chance with winrate_predictor.py.

research-ops.name: clinical-research
research-ops.description: Use when designing a prospective clinical study: choosing primary and secondary endpoints, estimating sample size and power, or scoring feasibility before submission. Runs endpoint_selector.py, sample_size_estimator.py and phase_gate_scorer.py; outputs are estimates for a biostatistician to confirm.

research-ops.name: interview-mapper
research-ops.description: Use when coding or making sense of one interview transcript (customer, JTBD, expert, usability, exit). Extracts verbatim-grounded nuggets with extract_nuggets.py, verifies quotes with verify_quotes.py and checks conclusions hold across reruns with consensus.py.

research-ops.name: market-research
research-ops.description: Use for market sizing (TAM, SAM, SOM both top-down and bottom-up), survey sample sizes or segment scoring. Runs market_sizer.py, sample_size_planner.py and segmentation_scorer.py and never returns one unsourced number.

research-ops.name: product-research
research-ops.description: Use when planning or synthesizing user research: choosing the method, deciding how many participants, or turning coded notes into insights. Runs study_designer.py, saturation_planner.py and insight_synthesizer.py, which refuses single-source insights.

research-ops.name: research-finance
research-ops.description: Use for R&D program money: multi-period budgets with indirect cost split, burn and runway against milestones, or capitalize vs expense routing. Runs program_budget_planner.py, burn_runway_tracker.py and capex_vs_opex_router.py.

research-ops.name: research-ops-skills
research-ops.description: Use when an enterprise research request needs routing (clinical study design, R&D finance, market sizing, user research): 'what sample size', 'R&D budget'. Lists the research-ops skills and routes to one.

compliance-os.name: ai-act-readiness
compliance-os.description: EU AI Act readiness: risk tier, duties, deadlines. Load whenever AI ships in the EU or the user asks if the Act applies.

compliance-os.name: aims-audit
compliance-os.description: ISO 42001 AI readiness check. Use before a stage 1 or internal audit, or /compliance-os:aims-audit.

compliance-os.name: compliance-os
compliance-os.description: Use when running several compliance frameworks at once: which apply, where controls overlap, a mock audit or one evidence checklist. Runs framework_selector.py, cross_framework_mapper.py, audit_simulator.py and evidence_pool_generator.py.

compliance-os.name: compliance-readiness
compliance-os.description: Use for /compliance-os:compliance-readiness, or before adding a framework or planning the annual audit calendar.

compliance-os.name: fda-qsr-audit-prep
compliance-os.description: Use for /compliance-os:fda-qsr-audit-prep, or before an FDA inspection, QMSR internal audit or Form 483 response.

compliance-os.name: gdpr-audit-prep
compliance-os.description: Use for /compliance-os:gdpr-audit-prep, or before a GDPR review, post-breach audit or DPA investigation.

compliance-os.name: iso13485-audit-prep
compliance-os.description: Use for /compliance-os:iso13485-audit-prep, or before an ISO 13485 internal audit or DHF closure.

compliance-os.name: iso27001-audit-prep
compliance-os.description: Use for /compliance-os:iso27001-audit-prep, or before an ISO 27001 internal, surveillance or stage 1 audit.

compliance-os.name: soc2-audit-prep
compliance-os.description: Use for /compliance-os:soc2-audit-prep, or before or during a SOC 2 Type II observation period.

markdown-html.name: design-system
markdown-html.description: Use when setting up brand settings before the first markdown-to-HTML conversion, or changing them. Runs a 10-question onboarding with onboard.py (colors, fonts, style, TOC) and refuses palettes that fail WCAG AA via brand_palette_validator.py.

markdown-html.name: markdown-html-orchestrator
markdown-html.description: Use when the user wants a markdown file turned into a single-file interactive HTML page (document, code review or slide deck). Classifies it with doctype_classifier.py and routes to md-document, md-review or md-slides.

markdown-html.name: md-document
markdown-html.description: Use when converting long-form markdown (spec, RFC, report, plan) into a single-file HTML page with sticky TOC, search and code-copy. Parses with markdown_parser.py and renders with html_renderer.py using the design-system brand.

markdown-html.name: md-review
markdown-html.description: Use when converting a markdown code review with diff blocks and severity callouts into a two-column HTML review. Parses diffs with diff_parser.py and annotations with annotation_extractor.py; requires a named reviewer.

markdown-html.name: md-slides
markdown-html.description: Turn a markdown file into a single-file HTML slide deck with keyboard navigation, presenter notes and print-to-PDF. Use whenever the user wants slides or a presentation from markdown or notes.

agent-launcher.name: agent-launcher-orchestrator
agent-launcher.description: Use when someone wants to build, launch, grade or schedule a Claude Managed Agent in their own Anthropic account ('build me an agent', 'run this nightly'). Reads the session goal, routes with goal_router.py and compiles the loop with loop_compiler.py.

agent-launcher.name: grade-iterate
agent-launcher.description: Use when a launched managed agent needs grading against a rubric and improving ('grade my agent', 'is it good enough'). Builds the outcome with outcome_builder.py, reads verdicts with verdict_reader.py and runs held-back evals from eval_scaffold.py.

agent-launcher.name: interview
agent-launcher.description: Use when someone has an agent idea to scope before launch ('help me scope an agent'). Interviews them about the one job and writes a build sheet with build_sheet_builder.py, checked by primitives_validator.py; no API key needed.

agent-launcher.name: run-without-you
agent-launcher.description: Use when a graded managed agent should run on a schedule, on an event trigger or on demand ('run it every morning'). Validates cron with cron_validator.py and builds the deployment with deployment_builder.py.

agent-launcher.name: stage-launch
agent-launcher.description: Use when a managed-agent build sheet is ready to launch ('launch it', 'deploy the agent'). Generates and validates API payloads with payload_generator.py and payload_validator.py and writes a resumable curl script with launch_script_writer.py that uses the user's own key.

agent-launcher.name: wrap-up
agent-launcher.description: Use when closing out a launched managed agent ('wrap up', 'what do I own now'). Inventories primitives with primitives_inventory.py, regenerates the overview with overview_page.py and suggests next upgrades with upgrade_suggester.py.

c-level-agents.name: boardroom
c-level-agents.description: Use for /c-level-agents:boardroom, or a decision spanning several executive domains (a pricing change, raise vs cut). Runs a 6-phase C-suite deliberation and writes a board memo.

c-level-agents.name: brief
c-level-agents.description: Use for /c-level-agents:brief, or to frame a strategic question (options, assumptions, success criteria) as a one-page brief before deliberation.

c-level-agents.name: c-level-agents
c-level-agents.description: Use when the founder wants a virtual executive team or a /c-level-agents command. Lists the 13 C-suite agents and 21 commands and routes multi-role decisions.

c-level-agents.name: caio-review
c-level-agents.description: Use for /c-level-agents:caio-review, or to challenge a plan involving AI (no eval set, API vs fine-tune vs self-host, EU AI Act class).

c-level-agents.name: cco-review
c-level-agents.description: Challenge a churn, retention, segment or CS hiring plan. Use whenever asked or /c-level-agents:cco-review.

c-level-agents.name: cdo-review
c-level-agents.description: Use for /c-level-agents:cdo-review, or to challenge a plan touching training-data rights, data architecture or data monetization.

c-level-agents.name: cfo-review
c-level-agents.description: Challenge a plan that spends real money: hiring wave, raise, channel budget. Use whenever asked or /c-level-agents:cfo-review.

c-level-agents.name: ciso-review
c-level-agents.description: Challenge a plan touching customer data, compliance or prod access. Use when asked or /c-level-agents:ciso-review.

c-level-agents.name: cmo-review
c-level-agents.description: Use for /c-level-agents:cmo-review, or to challenge positioning, ICP, messaging or channel mix before a launch.

c-level-agents.name: cpo-review
c-level-agents.description: Challenge a roadmap, PMF claim or feature kill. Use whenever asked or /c-level-agents:cpo-review.

c-level-agents.name: cro-review
c-level-agents.description: Challenge a forecast, win-rate drop or sales hires. Use whenever asked or /c-level-agents:cro-review.

c-level-agents.name: cross-eval
c-level-agents.description: Use for /c-level-agents:cross-eval, or when a high-stakes memo needs independent review by several models before the boardroom.

c-level-agents.name: cto-review
c-level-agents.description: Challenge an architecture bet, 10x scaling plan or rebuild vs buy. Use whenever asked or /c-level-agents:cto-review.

c-level-agents.name: decide
c-level-agents.description: Use for /c-level-agents:decide, or right after the founder approves a boardroom memo, to log it as a durable decision.

c-level-agents.name: execute
c-level-agents.description: Use for /c-level-agents:execute, or to turn an approved decision into a 90-day plan with weekly milestones and owners.

c-level-agents.name: founder-mode
c-level-agents.description: Use for /c-level-agents:founder-mode, or any founder strategy question that hasn't been routed yet. Sends it to the right C-suite advisor or the boardroom.

c-level-agents.name: freeze
c-level-agents.description: Use for /c-level-agents:freeze, or to put a cooling-off lock on an irreversible decision made under pressure.

c-level-agents.name: gc-review
c-level-agents.description: Use for /c-level-agents:gc-review, or to challenge a term sheet, customer MSA, IP assignment or regulatory exposure before signing.

c-level-agents.name: office-hours
c-level-agents.description: Founder advice after six YC-style questions. Use whenever a founder is stuck or unsure what to ask, or /c-level-agents:office-hours.

c-level-agents.name: onboard
c-level-agents.description: Use for /cs-onboard, or when the virtual C-suite lacks company context. Interviews the founder and writes ~/.claude/company-context.md.

c-level-agents.name: post-mortem
c-level-agents.description: Use for /c-level-agents:post-mortem, or when a decision hits its 90-day review or kill criteria. Scores it against the original assumptions and dissent.

c-level-agents.name: vpe-review
c-level-agents.description: Challenge a plan on delivery speed, eng hiring, team structure or on-call. Use when asked or /c-level-agents:vpe-review.

loop-library.name: loop-library
loop-library.description: Discover, find, compare, audit, repair, adapt, and design repeatable AI-agent loops with explicit triggers, actions, verification, stopping conditions, guardrails, and handoffs. Use when a user asks to analyze a codebase for potential loops, mine coding-thread history for work done more than once, turn repeated engineering work into a loop, find or recommend a published loop, create a recurring agent workflow or automation cadence, turn an outcome into a bounded copy-ready loop, or review an existing loop for weak checks, unsafe authority, unbounded repetition, stale state, or unclear stopping behavior.
